instruction.text: Form the sentence in the future progressive tense.

hint.text: Remember: pair the words will be with the progressive verb form to form the future progressive.
hint.sound: Remember: pair the words 'will be' with the progressive verb form to form the future progressive.

instruction.text: Fill in the gap with the future progressive form of the verb.

hint.text:
For verbs that end on a silent -e, you drop the -e before adding the ending -ing.

For example:
take → taking
hint.sound: ssml: For verbs that end on a 'silent -e', you drop the '-e' before adding the ending 'i n g. <break time='500ms'/> For example: <break time='500ms'/> 'take' <break time='500ms'/> which ends on a silent -e <break time='500ms'/> becomes 'taking'.
